resources.string: Customize One UI Home labels, recents orientation, wallpaper integration and volume panels.
Turn off to use the original behavior. Your individual settings are kept.
Send the real home page position through Android wallpaper offsets.
Use the live service in Wallpaper and style. Requires the Wallpaper and style scope.
Setting changes apply without restarting. New or updated modules need the target process to reload.
Could not restart One UI Home. Check root permission.
Restarts only One UI Home using root. The device is not rebooted.
Root permission is unavailable. Process restart and protection reset need root.
If a hook is not confirmed, enable the module in Vector, select the required app scope and reload that process. Installing the manager alone does not activate hooks.
Root removes only this module’s guard files. Restart the affected process after checking the cause.
Crash protection reset. Reload the affected process to retry.
Could not reset protection. Check root access.

Scope: One UI Home for labels, portrait recents and page notifications; System UI for the optional volume panel; Wallpaper and style for the optional live preview.

Verified baseline: SM-S948Q, Android 16, One UI Home 17.5.03.27, Vector 2.2. Incompatible structures are skipped. Android 17 and later require a new compatibility review.

Automatic home colors follow the wallpaper’s dark-text hint. Image changes without a color notification cannot be detected.

Crash protection can stop this module after repeated unstable starts. It cannot prevent failures inside Vector or failures before the app attaches.
License data could not be loaded.
This briefly closes the selected interface. It does not reboot the device.
Could not reload the target process. Check root access.
No wallpaper colors. Automatic mode uses the original behavior.
Hook response received. Tap for details.
Keep the recent apps screen upright when entering from a landscape app. App orientation stays unchanged. Not applied in multi-window mode or on external displays.
Hide the home bar in recent apps
Hide the gesture handle only on the recent apps screen. Three-button navigation is unaffected. The system’s always-hidden setting is preserved.
Following system visibility; no local override.

Home labels and Finder each use only the area around their text to choose black or white. Rechecks after home/page/layout events and wallpaper color notifications. Silent image changes may wait until the next event. Status bar colors are managed outside this module.
Moves the displayed date to the left of the time. Date visibility and format follow system and QuickStar settings. Off by default.
Standard grid for DIY Home icons

Keeps DIY Home enabled, aligns app icons and folders to the normal home grid, and snaps editing moves to cells. Widgets and stickers remain freely placed. Off displays the saved free positions; it does not undo edits. Portrait only; off by default.
Waiting for a response to this check. The target may be closed, waiting for settings, or unable to load the hook. This does not indicate that crash protection has stopped it.
Save app and folder positions on every home page. The positions remain without root or hooks. Widgets, sizes and rotation stay unchanged.
Save positions for %1$d apps and folders on %2$d pages?\n\nThese positions remain when the grid hook is off. Saving is cancelled if the layout changes during confirmation.
Saved %1$d positions. This layout remains visible when the grid hook is off.
The aligned positions are already saved.
Enable alignment, visit the home screen, finish editing, and try again. The One UI Home hook must be active.
The layout changed during confirmation. No positions were written. Preview the layout again.
The save could not be confirmed. Check the layout on Home before trying again.
